_doc: Warhammer 40,000: Battlesector (Unity 6, Addressables). Unity adapter on AssetStudioModCLI; the game-data tables (units, models, weapons, loadouts) are read by profiles/games/battlesector_data.py. backend: the settings the v1 Intercessor was built with (one global scale factor, Citadel bases with v1's terrain).
name: Warhammer 40,000: Battlesector

unity._doc_metres: metres per Blender-imported unit: the v1 factor 1758.838 mm per unit at 1:56-ish scale; a hint only (scale rule below decides)

scale._doc: v1: ONE global factor so units keep their in-game proportions (kept by Derek 2026-10-21). Eye-height targets per unit can override this in unit files.

base_finish._doc: Applied to every round/oval base (v1 chat fixes): sole/ground fill under hovering feet + textured terrain. Set base.terrain=false for a flat top.

sole_fill.note: terrain bases: ground rises to meet sole and welt undersides (normal z < -0.3) hovering up to 0.9 mm above the base top, embed_mm into the boot, sloping away at slope (height per mm, 0.7 = 35 deg), lightly blurred. Plain discs: prisms straight down from faces with normal z < -0.7

terrain.note: sized for a 0.2 mm FDM nozzle: grooves >= 0.5 mm wide, pebbles >= 0.35 mm. Feature counts scale with the top area (reference: 30 mm top); segments grow so the rim spacing stays <= grid_mm

connect_floating._doc: bigger models: road wheels behind tracks, dozer blades, armour plates sit 0.5-1.5 mm off the hull; bridge them with hidden struts
connect_floating._doc_drop: loose bits still separate after bridging and smaller than this (rivets, 2 mm studs) cannot print as loose pieces: dropped and listed in build.json (dropped_loose_parts)

pose_select._doc: user 2026-10-21: real bike kits stand upright, lift the front wheel, or lean gently; the game's parked-bike lean (~23 deg) overhangs the oval. Side lean is penalised above 6 deg and excluded above 12; wheel lifts are fine.
pose_select._doc_pitch: front-wheel lifts up to ~15 deg (user: real kits lift the front wheel); a full wheelie (Warbiker Move_Start f25, ~45 deg) stands on the rear wheel and overruns the oval

connect_floating._doc: bikes: armour plates, exhausts and guns sit up to ~1.5 mm off the frame; same bridging as walkers
connect_floating._doc_drop: loose bits still separate after bridging and smaller than this (rivets, 2 mm studs) cannot print as loose pieces: dropped and listed in build.json (dropped_loose_parts)

pose_select._doc_hover: prefer frames with the feet on the ground (Hive Tyrant idles in the air); a pose that still hovers gets a flying-stand socket instead of balancing on a toe or tail tip

regression._doc: v1 Intercessor (user-chosen pose idle_01 frame 297, 32 mm Citadel base with terrain). The reference STL is a game derivative and is never shipped: only its metrics are. Build your own reference locally to compare surfaces.

tolerance._doc: Approved by Derek 2026-11-07 for 0.05 mm voxels under the 16 GB cap (v1 was 0.03 mm at 31 GB: p99 0.03, max 0.15). Measured at 0.05 mm: p99 0.091/0.057, max 0.68/0.48 (shoulder-pad connector placement, rifle-front gap), volume 0.026 %, size 0.005 mm.
